title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a worked example for a lorry or a bicycle to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Session 2 only works with a 1000 kg car, but the same formulas apply to a lorry or a bicycle helmet drop.

## Context
A second example shows that a = v^2 / (2 d) does not depend on mass while F does.

## Expected outcome
A short extra example in the Session 2 README (and a matching check) with hand-calculated numbers.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/README.md`, `sessions/session-02/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Numbers verified by running the code
- [ ] Units stated for every quantity

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: an occupant and a belt
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: the shipped model has no occupant.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why the occupant's deceleration differs from the car's.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a staged crumple profile and a speed sweep
body:
## Problem
Session 3 has a single plateau; one plateau cannot serve low-speed and high-speed crashes.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A force law with two stages and a sweep over 40, 56 and 64 km/h that reports peak deceleration and stop distance.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint for the staged profile is met
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a tuned crumple zone with a live trace
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows two cars crashing with a live deceleration trace and an energy bar; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A GIF under 3 MB with a car, a live trace and an energy bar
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
